by
  intro p n hp hn hdvd hmin
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hp_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := by
    have hp_pos : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hp.two_le
    exact ne_of_gt hp_pos
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp_ne_zero⟩
  have hzero_to_dvd : ∀ a : ℕ, ((a : ZMod p) = 0) → p ∣ a := by
    intro a ha
    exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a p).1 ha
  have hdvd_to_zero : ∀ a : ℕ, p ∣ a → ((a : ZMod p) = 0) := by
    intro a ha
    exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a p).2 ha
  have pow_six_dvd : ∀ x : ℕ, 1 ≤ x → ((x : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) → p ∣ (x ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro x hx1 hx6
    apply hzero_to_dvd
    have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx1
    have hpos : 0 < x ^ 6 := pow_pos hxpos 6
    have hle : 1 ≤ x ^ 6 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
    simp [hx6]
  have hn6 : (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
    have h0 : ((n ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := hdvd_to_zero (n ^ 6 - 1) hdvd
    have hnpos : 0 < n := lt_trans zero_lt_one hn
    have hpos : 0 < n ^ 6 := pow_pos hnpos 6
    have hle : 1 ≤ n ^ 6 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle] at h0
    have h1 : ((n ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      have h0' : ((n ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) - 1 = 0 := by
        simpa using h0
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0'
    simpa using h1
  have source_step_0 : p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    have hfac : (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1 =
        (((n : ZMod p) - 1) * ((n : ZMod p) + 1) *
          ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) *
          ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1)) := by ring
    have hprod : (((n : ZMod p) - 1) * ((n : ZMod p) + 1) *
        ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) *
        ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hfac, hn6]
      ring
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hABC | hD
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hABC with hAB | hC
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hAB with hA | hB
        · left
          have h0 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub (le_of_lt hn)]
            simpa using hA
          exact hzero_to_dvd (n - 1) h0
        · right; left
          have h0 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
            simpa using hB
          exact hzero_to_dvd (n + 1) h0
      · right; right; left
        have h0 : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
          simpa using hC
        exact hzero_to_dvd (n ^ 2 + n + 1) h0
    · right; right; right
      have hnle : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
        have h : n * 1 ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (le_of_lt hn)
        simpa [pow_two] using h
      have hcastD : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
          (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hnle]
        simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one]
      have h0 : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
        rw [hcastD]
        exact hD
      exact hzero_to_dvd (n ^ 2 - n + 1) h0
  have source_step_1 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hA : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      have h0 : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := hdvd_to_zero (n ^ 2 + n + 1) hcase
      simpa using h0
    have hrel : (n : ZMod p) + 1 = -((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) := by
      have hsum : (n : ZMod p) + 1 + (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) + 1 + (n : ZMod p) ^ 2
              = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by ring
          _ = 0 := hA
      calc
        (n : ZMod p) + 1 = ((n : ZMod p) + 1 + (n : ZMod p) ^ 2) - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 0 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hsum]
        _ = -((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) := by ring
    have hb : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
      have hx : ((n : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 6 = 1 := by
        calc
          ((n : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 6 = (-((n : ZMod p) ^ 2)) ^ 6 := by rw [hrel]
          _ = (n : ZMod p) ^ 12 := by ring
          _ = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 1 := by rw [hn6]; ring
      simpa using hx
    exact pow_six_dvd (n + 1) (by exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) hb
  have source_step_2 : p ∣ (n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hx1 : (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      have h0 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := hdvd_to_zero (n + 1) hcase
      simpa using h0
    have hx2 : (n : ZMod p) + 2 = 1 := by
      calc
        (n : ZMod p) + 2 = ((n : ZMod p) + 1) + 1 := by ring
        _ = 0 + 1 := by rw [hx1]
        _ = 1 := by ring
    have hb : (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
      have hx : ((n : ZMod p) + 2) ^ 6 = 1 := by
        calc
          ((n : ZMod p) + 2) ^ 6 = (1 : ZMod p) ^ 6 := by rw [hx2]
          _ = 1 := by ring
      simpa using hx
    exact pow_six_dvd (n + 2) (by exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (n + 1))) hb
  have source_step_3 : p ∣ (n - 1) → p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by
      have hn_ne2 : n ≠ 2 := by
        intro hn2
        have hpdiv1 : p ∣ 1 := by
          simpa [hn2] using hcase
        have hp_le_one : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 1) hpdiv1
        have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
        have h21 : 2 ≤ 1 := le_trans hp_ge2 hp_le_one
        exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self 1) h21
      have hn_ge2 : 2 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn
      have hn_gt2 : 2 < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hn_ge2 (by intro h; exact hn_ne2 h.symm)
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn_gt2
    have hx : (n : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      have h0 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := hdvd_to_zero (n - 1) hcase
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (le_of_lt hn)] at h0
      simpa using (sub_eq_zero.mp h0)
    have hb : (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
      have hcast : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 2 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (le_trans (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3) hn3)]
        simp
      rw [hcast, hx]
      ring_nf
    exact pow_six_dvd (n - 2) (by
      have hn_gt2 : 2 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 2 < 3) hn3
      have hpos : 0 < n - 2 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hn_gt2
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos) hb
  have source_step_4 : p ∣ (n - 1) → n < 4 := by
    intro hcase
    by_contra hnot
    have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hm1 : 1 < n - 2 := by
      have h2 : 2 ≤ n - 2 := by
        have h : 4 - 2 ≤ n - 2 := Nat.sub_le_sub_right hn4 2
        simpa using h
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 1 < 2) h2
    have hm2 : n - 2 < n := Nat.sub_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one hn) (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
    have hdiv : p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := source_step_3 hcase
    exact hmin (n - 2) hm1 hm2 hdiv
  have source_step_5 : p ∣ (n - 1) → n = 3 := by
    intro hcase
    have hlt4 : n < 4 := source_step_4 hcase
    have hn23 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by
      have hn_ge2 : 2 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn
      have hn_le3 : n ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt4
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hn_ge2 with h | h
      · left; exact h.symm
      · right
        have hn_ge3 : 3 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt h
        exact le_antisymm hn_le3 hn_ge3
    rcases hn23 with hn2 | hn3
    · have hpdiv1 : p ∣ 1 := by
        rw [hn2] at hcase
        simpa using hcase
      have hp_le_one : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 1) hpdiv1
      have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
      have h21 : 2 ≤ 1 := le_trans hp_ge2 hp_le_one
      exact False.elim ((Nat.not_succ_le_self 1) h21)
    · exact hn3
  have source_step_6 : p ∣ (n - 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hn3 : n = 3 := source_step_5 hcase
    have hpdiv2 : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [hn3] at hcase
      simpa using hcase
    have hp_le2 : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hpdiv2
    have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
    have hp2 : p = 2 := le_antisymm hp_le2 hp_ge2
    rw [hn3, hp2]
    norm_num
  have source_step_7 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hnle : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
      have h : n * 1 ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (le_of_lt hn)
      simpa [pow_two] using h
    have hDcast : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
        (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hnle]
      simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one]
    have hD : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      have h0 : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := hdvd_to_zero (n ^ 2 - n + 1) hcase
      rw [hDcast] at h0
      exact h0
    have hrel : (n : ZMod p) - 1 = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by
      have hsum : (n : ZMod p) - 1 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        calc
          (n : ZMod p) - 1 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1) := by ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [hD]; ring
      calc
        (n : ZMod p) - 1 = ((n : ZMod p) - 1 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2) + (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 0 + (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by rw [hsum]
        _ = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hb : (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
      have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (le_of_lt hn)]
        simp
      rw [hcast]
      calc
        ((n : ZMod p) - 1) ^ 6 = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) ^ 6 := by rw [hrel]
        _ = (n : ZMod p) ^ 12 := by ring
        _ = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 1 := by rw [hn6]; ring
    exact pow_six_dvd (n - 1) (by
      have hpos : 0 < n - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hn
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos) hb
  have source_step_8 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → n = 2 := by
    intro hcase
    by_contra hne
    have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by
      have hn_ge2 : 2 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn
      have hn_gt2 : 2 < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hn_ge2 (by intro h; exact hne h.symm)
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn_gt2
    have h1 : 1 < n - 1 := by
      have h2 : 2 ≤ n - 1 := by
        have h : 3 - 1 ≤ n - 1 := Nat.sub_le_sub_right hn3 1
        simpa using h
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 1 < 2) h2
    have h2 : n - 1 < n := Nat.sub_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one hn) (by norm_num : 0 < 1)
    have hdiv : p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := source_step_7 hcase
    exact hmin (n - 1) h1 h2 hdiv
  have source_step_9 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hn2 : n = 2 := source_step_8 hcase
    have hpdiv3 : p ∣ 3 := by
      rw [hn2] at hcase
      have h3 : (2 ^ 2 - 2 + 1 : ℕ) = 3 := by norm_num
      rw [h3] at hcase
      exact hcase
    have hp_le3 : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 3) hpdiv3
    have hp_cases : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by
      have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hp_ge2 with h | h
      · left; exact h.symm
      · right
        have hp_ge3 : 3 ≤ p := Nat.succ_le_of_lt h
        exact le_antisymm hp_le3 hp_ge3
    rcases hp_cases with hp2 | hp3
    · have hnot : ¬ (2 ∣ 3) := by norm_num
      rw [hp2] at hpdiv3
      exact False.elim (hnot hpdiv3)
    · rw [hp3, hn2]
      norm_num
  have source_step_10 : p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) ∨ p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    rcases source_step_0 with h1 | hrest
    · exact Or.inr (source_step_6 h1)
    · rcases hrest with h2 | hrest
      · exact Or.inr (source_step_2 h2)
      · rcases hrest with h3 | h4
        · exact Or.inl (source_step_1 h3)
        · exact Or.inr (source_step_9 h4)
  exact source_step_10

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。逐一讨论。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。
若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。
因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。
若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。

steps.explanation: Lean 的 source_step_7 对应情形四：由 p|(n²−n+1) 得 n−1=n² mod p，再推出 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1，并转化为整除差式。

steps.originalExcerpt: 若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。
steps.leanEvidenceExcerpt: have source_step_8 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → n = 2 := by
steps.explanation: Lean 的 source_step_8 用最小性假设 hmin 对 m=n−1 应用：若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n 且 p|((n−1)^6−1)，产生矛盾，故 n=2。与作者推理一致。

steps.leanEvidenceExcerpt: have source_step_9 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
steps.explanation: Lean 的 source_step_9 在 n=2 时由 p|3 及 p 为素数推出 p=3（实现中先得 p=2 或 p=3 再排除 p=2），并验证 p|((n+2)^6−1)。这与原文结论一致。

steps.originalExcerpt: 以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。
steps.explanation: Lean 的 source_step_10 对 source_step_0 得到的四种因子情形逐一应用前面相应的分支结论，从而得到最终析取。对应原文“四种情形穷尽所有可能”的收尾。

originalAudit.modelSummary: 逐项比较显示，Lean 证明项中的各 source_step 与作者原证明的四种情形及最小性排除逻辑相对应；ZMod p、自然数减法和整除/取模转换属于形式化实现技术，未发现作者关键数学理由被遗漏或被替换为额外大定理。整体仅能说明未识别到具体忠实性疑点，不构成对原证明的独立完整认证。
